The '''1929–30 Scottish Division One''' season was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by five points over nearest rival [[Motherwell F.C.|Motherwell]]. [[Dundee United F.C.|Dundee United]] and [[St Johnstone F.C.|St Johnstone]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1930–31 Scottish Division Two]].
